notes:
Topline: strategic customer for secure RAG + reranking. Heavy focus on embeddings scale and deterministic latency in an air-gapped environment. Currently evaluating vendors for a 2-phase procurement: (1) on-site POC in Government Lab; (2) multi-year private deployment with reserved capacity and SLAs.

- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable p95 under 150ms for single-turn search + rerank on 12k token context. Air-gapped proof is non-negotiable."
- Index scale requirement: target initial corpus 120M documents (text + PDFs), eventual scale to 500M+ objects; average doc length 800 tokens, expected vector DB size ~600M vectors (1536 dim).
- Query profile: mix of high-throughput automated ingest (batched embeddings) + interactive analyst search peaks ~200 QPS; burst to 1000 QPS during incidents.
- Latency SLOs: 95th <=150ms for embedding-based k-NN + lightweight rerank; end-to-end with re-ranker <=300ms.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement looking to cap per-query amortized cost ~"0.2-0.5c" (USD) for standard queries, willing to pay more for critical workflows. Wants Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching, quantization and hybrid indexing to meet cost goal.
- Model preferences: open/quantized Llama/Falcon variants allowed; need deterministic rerank model (smaller distil model fallback) and consistent outputs for audits. No outbound cloud calls; models must run entirely on-prem (air-gapped).
- Security: mandatory KMS/HSM integration (FIPS 140-2), SSO via SAML, full audit logs + 7-year retention for queries and model decision traces. Data residency: must live in government-controlled racks.
- Architecture constraints: separate compute and storage clusters, explicit IL-4/IL-5 compliance path, limited egress, hardware floor: 2 x DGX/A100 racks for baseline POC, future scale plan to 8+ racks.
